utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I’m still looking for a few more helpers on Saturday at the front porch. Do you know anyone who can pitch in?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, I must’ve missed that update too—who still needs to be covered on Saturday? I can ask around if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Noah — I still need a couple more helpers for the front porch on Saturday. If you can ask around, that’d really help.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks for the reminder, Rosa — I’ll make sure everyone knows it’s Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Tess — I appreciate it. Let me know if anything changes, and I’ll keep coordinating from here.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Will do, Rosa — I’ll let folks know if anything changes and keep an eye out for Manny.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: 9 works for me—I’ll help set out the tables and sign-in sheet by the community center, and I’ll work around the school schedule. Thanks, Quinn.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, thanks, Faye! I’ll keep spreading the word so everyone knows to meet at the community center at 9.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sounds good—I’ll be there at 9 and set everything up at the community center. Thanks for coordinating the word, Quinn.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late—how’s the repair drive going? Did we get many people to show up?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: We’re still getting set up, so I’m not sure yet on turnout. I’m keeping track of the supplies, and we’re aiming to start at 10 once the tables are ready.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it—sorry again for being late. Do you want me to help set up the tables or sort the supplies?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: 9 AM by the community center still works for me. I’ve got the work gloves and screwdriver ready.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Great, I’ll pass that along. Anything else you still need for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: No, that should do it for me—just keep me posted if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: 10 sounds good for the repair drive. I can help with setup around 9 if needed.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: 10 works for me, and 9 is great for setup if you can make it. Please bring the tape and spare screws, and I’ll handle the rest.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Will do — I’ll bring the tape and spare screws, and I’ll be there at 9 for setup.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard the repair drive's getting set up—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Nell — I just need the latest location details for the repair drive so I can pass them along.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I don’t have the exact location yet, just that it’s being set up. I can ask around and pass it along as soon as I hear it.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Mara — that’d be helpful. Just let me know the final details when you’ve got them, and I’ll keep spreading the word.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’ll confirm the final details and send them your way soon. Thanks for helping spread the word!

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good, Mara — I’ll keep an eye out and help however I can.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just making sure — the repair drive is still on for today at 3, right?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m still waiting on the latest repair-drive details, but I’ll pass them along as soon as I hear them.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, thanks — please let me know as soon as you have the details.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’m still waiting on Hana’s confirmation, but I can bring a few extra tools just in case. If it’s on, I’m ready to help out.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Gus — that’d be a big help. I’m still sorting the final details, but I’ll let you know as soon as Hana confirms.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No problem — I’ll keep the tools handy and wait for your update. Just let me know as soon as Hana confirms.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Vik — could you help spread the word that the repair drive is now Sunday at the community center? If you can, it’d also help a lot to set up when you arrive.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sure — I’ll keep mentioning the repair drive around the block, and I can help set up when I get there on Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Vik — that really helps. I appreciate you spreading the word and coming early to set up.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I can help out with the repair drive—just point me to what needs doing first.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great, Bo — could you start by checking the front porch supplies and making a quick list of what’s missing?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure — I’ll check the front porch supplies and make a quick list of what’s missing.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — I’ll be there at 9 with gloves and a screwdriver.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, thanks Leo — I’ll make sure everyone knows to be there at 9. See you at the community center!

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: See you then — I’ll head to the community center at 9.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Yep, that’s right — we’re still on for today. I’ll head over and help with the tool table and small fixes.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, thanks Kira — 3 works for me. If you can bring a few basic hand tools, that’d be perfect.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Will do — I’ll bring my basic hand tools and be there at 3.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I heard the repair drive is coming up soon—what do you need help with?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, I must’ve missed the latest update—what changed on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m not sure what changed either—I just heard it’s coming up soon. If you want, I can ask around for the latest location details.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yes, a few more supplies would really help for Sunday at the community center. I can pass along a list if you’re ready.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m still double-checking the repair drive details, but it should be on today. If you send the list, I’ll make sure it gets passed along.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Great — I’ll send over the supply list now, and thanks for helping pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Vik — that really helps. If you can, just keep it on folks around the block and send anyone interested my way for Saturday at the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: You got it — I’ll keep mentioning the repair drive to folks around the block and send anyone interested your way for Saturday at the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Vik — I appreciate it. I’ll be at the front porch Saturday, so send anyone who wants to pitch in my way.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll keep track of what we’re short on and pass it along. If you spot anything missing, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, thanks Cleo—just send me the short list when you have it and I’ll help fill the gaps.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Will do — I’ll check what we have and send you the short list as soon as I can.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Sam — if you can help spread the word, that’d be a big help. We’re set for Sunday at the community center, and setting up when you arrive would mean a lot.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll help spread the word and I can help set up when I arrive. I’ve got the box of light bulbs ready for the repair drive, too.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Sam — that helps a lot. The box of light bulbs will be great when you get there.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m still waiting on the latest repair-drive details, but I’ll pass them along as soon as I hear them.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it—just let me know when the details come in, and I can help sort or label things for Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Will do — I’ll send them over as soon as I hear the latest repair-drive update.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Nell — the repair drive is now Sunday at the community center. If you can help spread the word, I’d really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, got it — I can help spread the word about Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Nell — that would be a huge help. I’ll let you know if anything else comes up for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive — I’m happy to help out, though I may need a quick reminder about the details again.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: No problem — we’re meeting at 9 AM by the community center. I’ll bring my gloves and screwdriver.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Eli — 9 AM by the community center, got it. I’ll be there and can help however I can.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: 3 works for me—I'll bring the tape and spare screws, and I’ll help set up when I arrive.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, 3 works for me too—I’ll be there by 9 to help set up the tables and sign-in sheet.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Faye—that helps a lot. I’m still a little worried about the timing, so I’ll double-check the Sunday details and let everyone know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks — if you have the latest location details for the repair drive, I can pass them along.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: It’s this Saturday at my front porch. Please pass that along, and tell me if you need anything else for the drive.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Mina — I’ll pass along that it’s this Saturday at your front porch. I’m all set for now, but I’ll let you know if anything else comes up.
